messages:
Elena Kim: quick check — ran a bulk-sample-surgery on llama2-13b-4bit (q3f) against our convo-devset, wanted to share preliminary notes.
Marcus Li: can you paste the config you used?
Elena Kim: sure, minimal snippet: 
```yaml
speculative:
  enabled: true
  early_fallback_thresh: 0.35
  max_speculative_steps: 6
sampling:
  topk: 40
  temp: 0.9
```
Priya Nair: results?
Elena Kim: latency: ~34% reduction p95 on short turns, cost down ~28% on hosted job. Quality: MRR down ~0.6 points on our rerank holdouts, ROUGE/sacreBLEU within expected variance on templated tests. Noticed token duplication on long-form conversation threads.
Jun Park: duplication — is it correlated with fallback events?
Elena Kim: looks likely. When speculative branch falls back to main decoder, KV lengths sometimes mismatch and we see repeated spans. Example stack snippet: 
```
RuntimeWarning: kv_cache_mismatch at step 14
  at decode_loop.py:215
```
ops-bot: Rolling canary deploy to dpool-ops-3 in 5m :gear:
Marcus Li: hypothesis: too many speculative steps => larger divergence before fallback. Try early_fallback_thresh=0.5 and max_speculative_steps=4 to reduce drift.
Elena Kim: ran a tiny canary with that config — duplication rate dropped ~70%, but latency improvement shrank to ~20% p95.
Priya Nair: also consider sampling entropy: lower temp reduces branching divergence. Temp 0.7 vs 0.9?
Elena Kim: scheduling a parameter sweep: thresholds [0.35,0.45,0.5], steps [4,6], temp [0.7,0.9]. Planning 2k eval dialogs, will upload artifacts + diffs.
Jun Park: also add a dev-only KV checksum on fallback path so we can catch mismatch without full trace. I'll open a small patch.
Elena Kim: added to backlog, PR #4872 (draft).
Marcus Li: one more note — 4-bit q3f quant sometimes folds biases differently; logits scale drift can amplify speculative mismatch. Re-run with bias-preserve quant and compare.
Elena Kim: yep re-running with bias-preserve and also with layernorm-fix patch. If MRR regression > 1.0 we'll rollback canary.
Priya Nair: sgtm. document the exact seed list + prompt templates so evals are reproducible.
Elena Kim: will do. snapshots: /s3/eng-ml/canaries/1799999991/artifacts.tar.gz
Marcus Li: thx team, ping when the matrix finishes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary deployment completed to 1/3 hosts :white_check_mark:
Elena Kim: thanks — will post final numbers in this thread later today :v:
